title: Update service copy for Carpet/Mattress/AC and add “sofa cleaning near me” phrase

requirements.text: Update the user-facing marketing copy line(s) for Carpet Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, and AC Water Jet Service across the landing page so the wording is improved/changed while keeping the same services, pricing, and CTA destinations unchanged.

quotes: Carpet, mattress & ac service line chang

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/components/landing/Services.tsx, the description text for the following service cards is updated: 'Carpet Cleaning in Ahmedabad', 'Mattress Cleaning in Ahmedabad', and 'AC Water Jet Service in Ahmedabad'.
Service titles, pricing values, and the AC sub-service list/prices remain exactly as currently implemented.
No changes are made to any Call/WhatsApp/Instagram/Google Business Profile links or their destinations.

requirements.text: Add the exact SEO phrase "sofa cleaning near me" into visible on-page marketing copy in a natural, non-spammy way (English only), without changing page structure or any CTA destinations.

quotes: and sofa cleaning near me add

acceptanceCriteria: The exact phrase "sofa cleaning near me" appears in at least one visible paragraph of copy on the landing page (e.g., in the Hero supporting paragraph in frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx and/or the Services intro paragraph in frontend/src/components/landing/Services.tsx).
The phrase is added in a grammatically natural way (not repeated multiple times).
All existing CTA buttons/links (tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram, Google Business Profile) remain unchanged.

requirements.text: If the Hero headline line that mentions "Carpet, Mattress & AC Services" is adjusted as part of the requested service line changes, keep it English-only and ensure it remains consistent with the Services section offerings (Carpet Cleaning, Mattress Cleaning, AC Water Jet Service).

quotes: Carpet, mattress & ac service line chang

acceptanceCriteria: Any updated Hero headline/subheadline text in frontend/src/components/landing/Hero.tsx remains English-only.
The Hero headline/subheadline continues to reference Carpet, Mattress, and AC services without implying any new services not present in the Services section.
No layout changes are introduced to the Hero section beyond text changes.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not change any existing CTA destinations/links, including tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram link, and Google Business Profile link.
Do not change service pricing amounts or the set/order of services already shown.
Frontend immutable paths must not be edited (per SYSTEM_CONTEXT).
nonGoals: Adding new services, sections, or navigation items.
Changing images, logo assets, or generating new graphics.
Reworking global theme/styling beyond copy/line changes requested.
